reason: In pkg/storage/unified/resource/server.go:229-262, NewResourceServer creates a cancelable context and calls s.Init(ctx), returning (nil, err) on failure without calling cancel() or s.lifecycle.Stop. If s.search.init(ctx) (server.go:305) succeeds before s.initWatcher() (server.go:310) fails, the watch goroutine in pkg/storage/unified/resource/search.go:203-213 and the SQL poller goroutine in pkg/storage/unified/sql/backend.go:566-578 (stopped only via backend.Stop) remain leaked.
